arxiv-2311-15441.title: Lattice Path Delta Matroids
arxiv-2311-15441.creator: Douglas M. Chen and Mario Sanchez and John Veliz and Zhiyan Ying
arxiv-2311-15441.description: Abstract . We initiate the study of a type C n C_{n} generalization of the lattice path matroids defined by Bonin, de Mier, and Noy. These are delta matroids whose feasible sets are in bijection with lattice paths which are symmetric along the main diagonal.

arxiv-2402-05991.title: Using JWST transits and occultations to determine ∼ \sim 1% stellar radii and temperatures of low-mass stars
arxiv-2402-05991.creator: Alexandra S. Mahajan, Jason D. Eastman, James Kirk
arxiv-2402-05991.description: Abstract Using JWST observations of a primary transit and two secondary eclipses for GJ 1214b, we determine an eccentricity that is more precise than a decade of HARPS data, which enables us to measure the stellar density to 2.62 2.62 %.

arxiv-2404-02088.title: LastResort at SemEval-2024 Task 3: Exploring Multimodal Emotion Cause Pair Extraction as Sequence Labelling Task
arxiv-2404-02088.creator: Suyash Vardhan Mathur, Akshett Rai Jindal, Hardik Mittal, Manish Shrivastava
arxiv-2404-02088.description: Abstract Conversation is the most natural form of human communication, where each utterance can range over a variety of possible emotions. While significant work has been done towards the detection of emotions in text, relatively little work has been done towards finding the cause of the said emotions, especially in multimodal settings.

arxiv-2405-06759.title: Prescribed Time Dual-Mode Extremum Seeking Control footnoteinfo
arxiv-2405-06759.creator: A. Waterman, D. Dochain, M. Guay
arxiv-2405-06759.description: Abstract We propose a dual mode extremum seeking control design technique that achieves real-time optimization of an unknown measured cost function in a prescribed time. The controller is shown to achieve semi-global practical stability of the optimal equilibrium for the state variables and the input variable for a class of nonlinear dynamical control systems with unknown dynamics.

arxiv-2410-14062.title: Data-driven rainfall prediction at a regional scale: a case study with Ghana
arxiv-2410-14062.creator: Indrajit Kalita, Lucia Vilallonga, Yves Atchade
arxiv-2410-14062.description: Abstract With a warming planet, tropical regions are expected to experience the brunt of climate change, with more intense and more volatile rainfall events. Currently, state-of-the-art numerical weather prediction (NWP) models are known to struggle to produce skillful rainfall forecasts in tropical regions of Africa. There is thus a pressing need for improved rainfall forecasting in these regions.

arxiv-2502-02263.title: Asymptotic solution for three-dimensional reaction-diffusion-advection equation with periodic boundary conditions
arxiv-2502-02263.creator: Aleksei Liubavin, Mingkang Ni, Ye Zhang, Dmitrii Chaikovskii
arxiv-2502-02263.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate the dynamics of moving fronts in three-dimensional spaces, which form as a result of in-situ combustion during oil production. This phenomenon is also observed in other contexts, such as various autowave models and the propagation of acoustic waves. Our analysis involves a singularly perturbed reaction-diffusion-advection type initial-boundary value problem of a general form.

arxiv-2502-09389.title: S 2 -Diffusion: Generalizing from Instance-level to Category-level Skills in Robot Manipulation
arxiv-2502-09389.creator: Quantao Yang, Michael C. Welle, Danica Kragic, Olov Andersson
arxiv-2502-09389.description: Abstract Recent advances in skill learning has propelled robot manipulation to new heights by enabling it to learn complex manipulation tasks from a practical number of demonstrations. However, these skills are often limited to the particular action, object, and environment instances that are shown in the training data, and have trouble transferring to other instances of the same category.

arxiv-2503-18760.title: Synthetic Function Demonstrations Improve Generation in Low-Resource Programming Languages
arxiv-2503-18760.description: Abstract A key consideration when training an LLM is whether the target language is more or less resourced, for example English compared to Welsh, or Python compared to Excel. Typical training data for programming languages consists of real program demonstrations coupled with explanatory human-written comments.

arxiv-2505-01368.title: Identifying regions for asymptotic expansions of amplitudes: fundamentals and recent advances
arxiv-2505-01368.creator: Yao Ma
arxiv-2505-01368.description: Abstract This review paper discusses the identification of regions, a crucial first step in applying the “method-of-regions” technique. A systematic approach based on Newton polytope geometry has proven successful and efficient for many cases. However, obtaining the correct list of regions becomes increasingly subtle with higher loop numbers or specific Feynman graph topologies.

arxiv-2508-04700.title: SEAgent: Self-Evolving Computer Use Agent with Autonomous Learning from Experience
arxiv-2508-04700.creator: Zeyi Sun, Ziyu Liu, Yuhang Zang, Yuhang Cao, Xiaoyi Dong, Tong Wu, Dahua Lin, Jiaqi Wang
arxiv-2508-04700.description: Abstract Repurposing large vision-language models (LVLMs) as computer use agents (CUAs) has led to substantial breakthroughs, primarily driven by human-labeled data. However, these models often struggle with novel and specialized software, particularly in scenarios lacking human annotations. To address this challenge, we propose SEAgent, an agentic self-evolving framework enabling CUAs to autonomously evolve through interactions with unfamiliar software.

arxiv-2511-12253.title: The Search for Constrained Random Generators
arxiv-2511-12253.creator: Harrison Goldstein, Hila Peleg, Cassia Torczon, Daniel Sainati, Leonidas Lampropoulos, Benjamin C. Pierce
arxiv-2511-12253.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Harrison Goldstein, Hila Peleg, Cassia Torczon, Daniel Sainati, Leonidas Lampropoulos, Benjamin C. Pierce. Among the biggest challenges in property-based testing (PBT) is the constrained random generation problem : given a predicate on program values, randomly sample from the set of all values satisfying that predicate, and only those values.

arxiv-2512-01346.title: Floquet Chern Insulators and Radiation-Induced Zero Resistance in Irradiated Graphene
arxiv-2512-01346.creator: Youngjae Kim and Kwon Park ∗
arxiv-2512-01346.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Youngjae Kim and Kwon Park ∗. Recent advances in optics and time-resolved techniques have facilitated the exploration of new states of matter under nonequilibrium conditions. Here, we predict that irradiated graphene can host two novel nonequilibrium steady states of matter with zero resistance when exposed to circularly polarized light: (i) Floquet Chern insulators and (ii) a radiation-induced zero-resistance state with spontaneous formation of an inhomogeneous current distribution.

arxiv-2602-18155.title: Stability of the Shape for Circular Vortex Filaments under Non-Symmetric Perturbations
arxiv-2602-18155.creator: Masashi Aiki, Mitsuo Higaki
arxiv-2602-18155.description: Abstract We establish the nonlinear orbital stability of circular vortex filaments governed by the Localized Induction Equation (LIE) under non-symmetric perturbations, within the framework of Tani-Nishiyama [ 9 ] . This result extends the first author’s recent work [ 1 ] by removing symmetry assumptions on perturbations.
